mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_request(session_id, user_id, request_hash, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{requestHash}, 'ACCEPTED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, user_id AS userId, request_hash AS requestHash, status, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, error_code AS errorCode, error_message AS errorMessage, model_route AS modelRoute, usage_json AS usageJson, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chat_request WHERE id = #{requestId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_request SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{requestId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'

UPDATE chat_request SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', model_route = #{modelRoute}, usage_json = #{usageJson}, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{requestId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE chat_request SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{requestId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE chat_request SET status = 'CANCELLED', error_code = 'RUN_CANCELLED', error_message = '本次回答已停止', finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{requestId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'RUNNING')
